summary_up_top.suggest: Add a one-sentence TL;DR at the very top explaining that this tracker refresh covers $690M in agent funding and new data sources.

edits.why: Navigation elements, text-size controls, audio players, and breadcrumbs are pushing the actual article content too far down on mobile screens.

edits.why: Dense paragraphs detailing funding rounds ($550M Temporal, $90M Nous, $50M AIR) are hard to parse on small screens.
